population: all distinct ordinary-Manual fixed-background single-person replacement team pairs at registered k=8,12,16,24; all failed attempts retained
known_task_baseline: frozen difficulty and team size k; no target worker answer quality
features: symmetric entrant mean/absolute contrast and background mean/SD of training-only task-adjusted Q, source log-time effect, and target-difficulty effect minus general Q; missing support explicit
double_exclusion: training-example worker features exclude both outer target building and training-example building; heldout features exclude target building
oracle_features: actual target local same-cluster relation and background shares for entrant clusters; raw geometry uses actual pair endpoint distance/count mismatch/floor 1-IoU. These are explanatory/oracle, never prospective personnel success.
model: fixed Ridge alpha=1, train-weighted standardized predictors, train-only median encoding plus missing indicators, prediction clipped to physical outcome range; the binary stable target uses a diagnostic linear probability model
weighting: equal buildings, equal images per building, equal available k per image, equal background draws per image/k, equal entrant pairs per background; weights sum to training image count
evaluation: leave-building-out MSE and MAE; aggregate pairs->background->image/k->building. Building bootstrap3000 seed2026101941. Report quality/floor valid denominators and joint-stability all-attempt denominator separately.
interpretation: This assesses predicting swap impact, independently from predicting a worker Q or local coassignment. Fixed finite model family, no outcome-based class/threshold retuning. Additional oracle information may explain but cannot prove a prospective team policy.
pilot_use: Pilot is interface verification only; adopted conclusions require current full comparison coverage. No historical holdout is renamed blind data.
